setup: pg_ctlcluster 16 main start 2>/dev/null; ln -sfn "$TOOLSMITH_EVAL_VENV" .venv && .venv/bin/python manage.py check 2>&1 | tail -2
name: hc-bug-nul-postgres
test: DB=postgres DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 DB_USER=postgres .venv/bin/python manage.py test hc.api.tests.test_list_checks
prompt: Bug report from production: the "List Checks" API call sometimes returns HTTP 500 Internal Server Error. It happens when a client sends a NUL character in a query parameter, e.g. `GET /api/v3/checks/?tag=%00` or `?slug=foo%00`. We cannot reproduce it on a laptop with the default setup, but production runs PostgreSQL (a PostgreSQL server is available on this machine at 127.0.0.1:5432, user `postgres`, no password). Expected: such requests get a 400 response with an error, never a 500.
